CITY OF SAN MARINO DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE AGENDA Christa Lakon, Chair www.cityofsanmarino.org Sharon Mequet, Vice Chair (626) 300­0700 Phone Raymond Cheng, Member San Marino City Hall Rick Chou, Member 2200 Huntington Drive Joyce Gatsoulis­Batnij, Member San Marino, CA 91108 REGULAR MEETING OF THE DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE WEDNESDAY, MAY 03, 2023 AT 6:00 PM BARTH ROOM CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY 1890 HUNTINGTON DRIVE SAN MARINO, CA 91108 The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Design Review Committee with valuable information regarding issues of the community. Regular meetings are held on the 1st and 3rd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City at (626) 300­0700 or at Planning@cityofsanmarino.org at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City will do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible. How to participate in the meeting from home: Via Computer for Video Streaming: Website: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/5719496876 Meeting ID: 571 949 6876 How to offer public comment from home: 1. Public comment will be accepted by email to Planning@CityofSanMarino.org before or during the meeting prior to the close of public comment on an item, to be read during public comment. Lengthy public comment may be summarized in the interest of time. 2. Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module during the meeting. CALL TO ORDER PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE ROLL CALL Alternate Suzanne Torgeson, Member Raymond Cheng, Member Rick Chou, Member Joyce Garsoulis­Batnij, Vice Chair Sharon Mequet, Chair Christa Lakon POSTING OF AGENDA The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall, 2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website: http://www.CityofSanMarino.org. PUBLIC COMMENTS The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Design Review Committee by completing a public comment card and giving it to the Community Development Director prior to the meeting. At this time, the public may address the Design Review Committee on items that are not on the agenda. Pursuant to state law, the Design Review Committee may not discuss or take action on issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.3). The Chair reserves the right to place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items. PUBLIC HEARINGS 1. CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL FOR DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL FOR DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR 23­03 AT 620 S. ALLEN AVENUE FOR WINDOW AND DOOR REPLACEMENTS WITH DESIGN ALTERATIONS (DAHL ARCHITECTS) Recommendation: B a s e d o n t h e i n f o r m a t i o n s u b m i t t e d t o t h e r e c o r d , s t a f f recommends that the Design Review Committee: (1) determine that based on the whole of the administrative record, the proposed roofing project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines, Section 15301, Class 1 (Existing Facilities), and that there is no substantial evidence demonstrating an exception to the categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2 applies; (2) find that the proposed project is compatible with the Neighborhood and with the structure itself; and (3) approve the project with the following conditions: 1. The existing decorative screens in front of each door shall remain or replaced in kind to match the same design and material. 2. The original stained­glass and leaded windows be protected in place as indicated on the plans; allowing all other window changes as proposed. NEW BUSINESS 3. DIRECTOR'S REPORT This is an opportunity for the Community Development Director to inform the Design Review Committee and the public of any matters of interest. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will available for review at the City Council meeting.
